# pve_realm_sync_job (Resource)

Manages a realm-sync job (`/cluster/jobs/realm-sync`) that periodically syncs users and/or groups of an LDAP/AD realm from its upstream directory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Nightly sync job for the corporate LDAP realm.
resource "pve_realm_sync_job" "corp_nightly" {
  id              = "corp-nightly"
  realm           = "corp"
  schedule        = "mon..fri 02:30"
  scope           = "both"
  remove_vanished = "entry;acl"
  enable_new      = true
  enabled         = true
  comment         = "Nightly LDAP sync"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique job ID (PVE config ID, up to 64 characters). Changing the ID replaces the job.
- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID the job syncs. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `schedule` (String) Run schedule in the `systemd` calendar-event subset PVE accepts (e.g. `mon..fri 02:30`, `daily`, `sun *-1..7 02:30`), up to 128 characters. The resource validates the format against `GET /cluster/jobs/schedule-analyze` when the cluster is reachable.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Description for the job (up to 512 characters).
- `enable_new` (Boolean) Enable newly synced users immediately. Defaults to `true`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Determines if the job is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `remove_vanished` (String) A semicolon-separated list of things to remove when they vanish during the sync: `entry` removes the user/group when not returned from the sync, `properties` removes properties of existing users/groups missing in the source, `acl` removes ACLs of vanished users/groups. `none` (the default) disables all removals, e.g. `entry;acl`.
- `scope` (String) Select what to sync. Must be one of `users`, `groups`, `both`.

### Read-Only

- `last_run` (Number) Last execution time of the job in seconds since the UNIX epoch; null before the first run.
- `next_run` (Number) Next planned execution time of the job in seconds since the UNIX epoch; null when unknown.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing realm-sync job by its job ID.
terraform import pve_realm_sync_job.corp_nightly corp-nightly
```
